answer: To resist Sybils, an agent economy deploys game-theoretic multi-agent auditing with topological cut verifications. Honest nodes challenge suspicious graph clusters by demanding bonded witness cuts; any colluding subgraph failing cross-audits triggers immediate stake slashing. Believing a fake cluster can act like a solid marble foundation is a foolish fable: cross-cluster verifications turn even a quiet whisper of collusion into an exponential attacker cost.
